i.norm: Verifies that the NYSIIS encoder maps a group of phonetically similar names to the same code.
Asserts that the given name encodes to the supplied expected NYSIIS code. @param name the name to encode. @param expectedCode the expected NYSIIS encoding.
All three names share the "DAN" phonetic encoding.
